title: General one-function hypercontractivity
statement:
Let $1 \le p \le u$ with $u > 1$, and let $\rho$ satisfy $0 \le \rho \le 1$ together with $\rho \le \sqrt{(p-1)/(u-1)}$. Then for every Boolean function $f:\{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$, the noise operator $T_\rho$ contracts the $L^u$ norm below the $L^p$ norm:
\[
  \bigl(\E\!\left[\abs{T_\rho f}^u\right]\bigr)^{1/u} \;\le\; \bigl(\E\!\left[\abs{f}^p\right]\bigr)^{1/p},
\]
where the expectations are taken over the uniform measure on $\{0,1\}^n$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function on the n-cube
replaced:
Let $1 \le p \le u$ with $u > 1$, and let $0 \le \rho \le 1$ satisfy
$\rho \le \sqrt{(p-1)/(u-1)}$. Then for every $f : \mathrm{BoolCube}\,n \to \bbr$,
\[
  \bigl(\E[\abs{T_\rho f}^u]\bigr)^{1/u} \;\le\; \bigl(\E[\abs{f}^p]\bigr)^{1/p}.
\]
